audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes his poke to a 'glaive' — no such ability exists in his kit. His long-range tool is the W stab that damages and then pulls you toward him, at 850 range on 14s. The full layer's cooldown block says 'R cleanses its CC if any', which is a placeholder: his CC is the Q recast knockup and the W pull, and his R carries none.
audit.why: A fabricated weapon name plus 'if any' means the page never tells the player which two casts Ragnarok is actually for. That is the whole level-6 decision.
audit.corrected: W is an 850-range stab-and-pull (14s); Q's recast knocks up (10s at rank 1); R stabs down and heals him (110s), no CC.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart hands Olaf Levels 2, 3, first item and two items, while the whys beside those exact rows say the opposite: 'his glaive punishes you every time Undertow is down', 'he wins the walk-up trade', 'the duel drifts his way', 'he scales slightly harder'.
audit.why: Four rows render a winner directly contradicted by their own explanation, on a 50.26% lane. The packet chart agrees with the prose, not the chart.
audit.corrected: Skill at Level 1, 4-5 and 6; Zaahen at Levels 2, 3, first item and two-plus items.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has three entries where four are expected (packet defect), and nothing anywhere mentions Determination — his passive grants stacking bonus AD and, when filled, increased AD and a revive.
audit.why: A revive changes the whole all-in calculus and the anti-heal timing: killing him once may not end the fight. That is the missing fourth spike, and it is verifiable straight from Riot's passive text.
audit.corrected: Added spikes[3] covering the filled-Determination revive window, via before: null.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line has no anti-heal at all, unlike every other healing-enemy page for this champion.
audit.why: Both Q and R heal him — Q on a 10s cooldown at rank 1 and R for a portion of damage dealt.
audit.corrected: Bramble added to the item line.

audit.why: 50.26% over 959 games — genuinely even, which the corrected chart now reflects.

edits.before: At 2 his glaive punishes you every time Undertow is down — the axe cooldown is his trade window.
edits.after: At 2 his 850-range pull punishes you every time Undertow is down — the axe cooldown is his window.

edits.before: Respect his windows: every time your axe misses or sits on cooldown, his glaive chips you for free, and by 3 his walk-up trades beat yours outright. Throw Undertow at last-hit timings and pickup angles rather than hope, and keep the wave close so his spacing game has less room to breathe.
edits.after: Respect his windows: every time your axe misses or sits its 9 seconds, his 850-range stab pulls you in for free, and by 3 his walk-up trades beat yours. Throw Undertow at last-hit timings and pickup angles rather than hope, and keep the wave close so his spacing game has less room to breathe.

edits.before: Landing the axe changes everything at 4-5 — slow, stick and trade back with true damage while W heals the difference. At 6 your Ragnarok all-in is genuinely scary, but only genuinely: he can still out-fight a whiffed engage, so commit off a landed Undertow and never off a prayer.
edits.after: Landing the axe changes everything at 4-5 — slow, stick and trade back with true damage while W's shield covers his answer. At 6 Ragnarok is for his Q recast knockup and his W pull, but he still out-fights a whiffed engage, so commit off a landed Undertow and never off a prayer.

edits.before: He out-scales you in exactly the fight your kit forces — long, CC-less slugfests — so stop offering them. Take skirmishes with teammates nearby, use Ragnarok to dive backlines instead of dueling him, and cash your unstoppability in fights where it matters more than out-trading one bruiser.
edits.after: He out-scales you in exactly the fight your kit forces — long slugfests — so stop offering them. Worse, a filled Determination bar lets him revive, so a duel you won can restart on you. Take skirmishes with teammates nearby, use Ragnarok to dive backlines instead of dueling him, and carry Grievous Wounds when you do commit.

notes: Zaahen is new and there is no wiki-independent way to check tenacity, cleanse or animation details, so nothing beyond Riot's own kit text was asserted. The E dash is flagged percentHealth in the kit but Riot's description ('dashes to a location and slices around himself') gives no percent-health wording, so no advice was built on it. The revive on filled Determination is the highest-value missing fact and was used for the created fourth spike.
